AKShare's A-share breadth remains a Sep 30 baseline; its Oct 7 14:02 Hong Kong snapshot had HSI down 0.50% and HSTECH down 0.81%. Overnight US indexes slipped, Russell 2000 fell 1.3% and the US 10-year closed near 5.28%; Micron gained 4.1% while TSMC lost 2.1%. 关键词云图

1.2万亿流动性沪指小涨医药领涨银行修复长债5.28%芯片承压盛美订单停牌重组飞龙降利恒指偏软
利好利空中性
重大新闻汇总
政策
央行今日加量投放三个月流动性
央行公告10月8日开展1.2万亿元、89天期买断式逆回购；10月同期限到期量为1万亿元，对应净加量2000亿元。流动性托底银行与高股息，但不能抵消公司层面的盈利风险。
政策
首套房贷贴息政策进入实施期
财政部、人民银行和金融监管总局的财金〔2026〕95号自10月1日起实施：合资格新发放首套房商业贷款获年化1个百分点、最长5年贴息，单户贴息贷款上限100万元；地产链需看成交兑现。
市场
A股开盘小涨，医药与银行接力
Google Finance于09:34记录沪指3853.58点、涨0.30%，深成指12910.56点、涨0.18%；财联社盘面显示生物制品+4.18%、医药+2.09%、银行+1.46%。节前AKShare宽度仅作旧基线，开盘轮动已转向医药与低估值权重。
港股
恒指低开后仍偏软，谨慎判断未改
Google Finance于09:28记录恒指24096.21点、跌0.14%，开盘24031.66点；10月7日AKShare宽度为679涨、958跌、1174平。跌幅较昨日收盘收窄但尚未转强，港股风险偏好仍需恒科与权重同步确认。
海外
美股冲高后回落，长债压制小盘
10月7日道指跌0.66%、标普500跌0.22%、纳指跌0.22%，罗素2000跌1.3%；10年期美债收益率收约5.28%。美光涨4.1%，台积电跌2.1%，芯片链不是单边信号。
产业
华为Mate 90以国产芯片与HarmonyOS 7强化自主链
华为发布Mate 90系列，采用Kirin 9050 Pro与HarmonyOS 7，高端机型性能较前代提升31%；同时公司承认先进芯片产能紧张且内存成本上升，利好与供给约束并存。
产业
盛美订单催化遭遇开盘板块反证
截至9月29日在手订单170.73亿元、同比增88.2%，但可靠同日盛美报价未取得；Google Finance开盘相关列表显示中芯国际-4.70%、中微公司-1.92%。订单逻辑仍在，状态维持条件关注但确认门槛提高。
公司
三安光电总经理解除留置
公司称10月5日收到解除留置通知，副董事长兼总经理林科闯已可正常履职，生产经营正常；这是治理不确定性边际缓解，仍需今日价格与后续披露确认。
公司
飞龙股份前三季度盈利明显下滑
公司预计归母净利润0.95亿至1.17亿元，同比下降59.2%至66.87%，原因包括行业竞争、原材料、汇率与新业务培育。9月30日收45.38元、跌2.45%，列回避。
公司
新亚制程筹划收购启元气体控股权
公司拟以发行股份及现金购买启元气体控股权并募资，预计构成重大资产重组，10月8日起停牌、预计不超过10个交易日披露方案。9月30日涨停收9.10元，条款与摊薄未知。
公司
荣丰控股筹划控制权变更
控股股东正筹划可能导致控股股东及实控人变更的事项，10月8日起停牌、预计不超过2个交易日。9月30日涨9.94%至18.69元，复牌前不能把事件当作已兑现收益。
HKEX
Z Fin 10月7日起短暂停牌
HKEX交易所通告显示Z Fin（01168）自10月7日上午9时起短暂停牌。停牌原因与复牌条件未形成可核验增量前，不进入多头候选。

美股夜盘行情总结

夜盘
夜盘指数
09:40 CST复核的高流动性代理显示：QQQ现金时段-0.25%、盘后+0.11%；DIA现金时段-0.69%、盘后-0.02%；SPY最新可核验口径仍为现金时段-0.24%。这些是代理且部分延迟，不写成指数期货。
对照
板块对照
美股排行快照未覆盖10月7日现金时段，首页行业与概念均为0行，因而没有代表ticker可逐项复核。QQQ由现金-0.25%转盘后+0.11%构成轻微潜在反转，DIA盘后仍负但跌幅收敛，综合结论为背离而非全面确认。
映射
A/H 映射
美股大盘代理的轻微修复未能抵消A股开盘芯片同业走弱；医药与银行成为新增强线，恒指仍偏软。若半导体相对强度回升且恒科翻红，才可撤销当前谨慎判断。

盘前结论

09:34沪指与深成指分别涨0.30%和0.18%，医药与银行领涨，流动性托底已转化为指数正收益。半导体设备和晶圆同业开盘走弱、恒指仍跌0.14%，高估值科技不能沿用节前预期追高。盛美上海只保留条件关注并提高相对强度门槛；停牌重组股等待条款，飞龙股份继续回避。

重点个股关注

盛美上海
A.688082
条件关注
事件：在手订单170.73亿元、同比增88.2%，对应半导体设备需求，但公司明确订单不等于最终收入。
最新反馈：可靠同日盛美报价未取得；09:35同业列表中中芯国际-4.70%、中微公司-1.92%，板块反证已增强。
确认/失效：只有后续取得可靠报价且盛美放量强于设备/晶圆同业才升级；持续弱于板块或交付延迟则失效。
荣丰控股
A.000668
条件关注
事件：控股股东筹划控制权变更，可能改变控股股东与实控人。
最近行情：9月30日收18.69元、涨9.94%；10月8日起停牌，当前无法交易且条款尚未披露。
确认/失效：只在复牌、披露对价与治理安排后评估；若无实质注资、摊薄过大或复牌负反馈则失效。
新亚制程
A.002388
条件关注
事件：拟以发行股份及现金收购启元气体控股权并募资，预计构成重大资产重组。
最近行情：9月30日涨停收9.10元；10月8日起停牌，交易方案、估值和摊薄尚未知。
确认/失效：仅待方案完整披露、复牌价格与交易所审核反馈后判断；高估值、重摊薄或复牌大跌即失效。
飞龙股份
A.002536
回避
事件：前三季度归母净利润预计同比下降59.2%至66.87%，价格竞争与成本压力均为实质负面。
最近行情：9月30日收45.38元、跌2.45%，公告后尚无新成交。
回避依据：盈利下修叠加节前负反馈；除非后续订单转化与利润率出现可核验反转，否则不因液冷概念包装为多头。

板块轮动看板

医药与银行生物制品+4.18%、医药+2.09%、银行+1.46%，成为开盘新增强线；持续性看成交与午前相对强度。
半导体设备/晶圆链订单催化仍在，但中芯国际与中微公司开盘同业反馈偏弱，盛美只作条件关注。
并购重组荣丰、新亚均停牌，只有条款、审核和复牌反馈能把事件转化为可交易判断。
高估值成长长债高位、港股偏软与芯片开盘反证共同提高追高风险。

逻辑链

央行净加量 → 节后指数小涨 → 银行先获低估值与流动性支撑，但仍需成交和资产质量确认。
医药板块开盘领涨 → 风格从单一科技预期转向业绩/事件驱动防御成长 → 午前相对强度是延续信号。
隔夜台积电走弱 + A股芯片同业开盘承压 → 盛美订单催化未获板块确认 → 只保留条件关注。
QQQ盘后轻微修复但恒指仍负 → 海外风险只边际缓和 → 恒科翻红与芯片相对强度回升前维持谨慎。

风险雷达

开盘分化指数小涨但医药银行与芯片方向相反，追逐单一假期叙事容易遭遇快速反转。
长债与油价10年美债约5.28%，Brent仍接近100美元，高估值与成本敏感行业承压。
重组条款真空荣丰与新亚停牌且核心条款未披露，任何收益判断都属未确认。
数据时效A股AKShare为9月30日，港股为10月7日14:02盘中；美股排行未覆盖10月7日现金时段，均已明确降级。

数据来源与时间点

增量窗口：2026-10-08 08:36至09:42 CST；复核3类增量，1类实质进入正文。国内发现源尝试金十、财联社/科创板日报，并以东方财富与证券时报信披页交叉；未发现改变判断的新增官方政策。09:34 Google Finance记录沪指3853.58/+0.30%、深成指12910.56/+0.18%；财联社复核时显示生物制品+4.18%、医药+2.09%、银行+1.46%。09:28 Google Finance记录恒指24096.21/-0.14%；HKEX定向复核未发现会改变判断的新增业绩、停复牌或澄清。09:40美股代理：QQQ现金-0.25%、盘后+0.11%，DIA现金-0.69%、盘后-0.02%，SPY最新可核验现金-0.24%；为部分延迟代理。AKShare schemaVersion=2、fetchedAt=2026-10-07 14:02 CST；A股marketDate=2026-09-30、marketPhase=previous_close_baseline，港股为10月7日盘中。美股排行fetchedAt=2026-10-07 09:47:59 CST、未覆盖10月7日现金时段，行业与概念均0行。更新时间：2026-10-08 09:42 CST。

Keyword Cloud

RMB1.2tn liquidityShanghai edges upPharma leadsBank reboundUS 10Y at 5.28%Chips under pressureACM backlogDeal suspensionsFeilong profit dropHang Seng soft
PositiveNegativeNeutral
Major News Roundup
Policy
PBOC adds three-month liquidity today
The PBOC will conduct RMB1.2tn of 89-day outright reverse repos on Oct 8. With RMB1tn maturing, the operation is a RMB200bn net add. It supports liquidity-sensitive sectors but does not override company earnings risk.
Policy
First-home mortgage subsidy enters force
MOF/PBOC/NFRA Circular Cai Jin [2026] 95 took effect Oct 1: eligible new first-home commercial mortgages receive a 1ppt annual subsidy for up to five years, capped at RMB1m of loan principal per household. Property-chain demand still needs transaction confirmation.
Market
A-shares edge up as pharma and banks take the lead
At 09:34 CST Google Finance showed the Shanghai Composite at 3,853.58, up 0.30%, and Shenzhen Component at 12,910.56, up 0.18%. CLS showed biological products +4.18%, pharma +2.09% and banks +1.46%. The pre-holiday AKShare breadth is now only a stale baseline.
Hong Kong
Hang Seng remains soft after a lower open
At 09:28 CST Google Finance showed HSI at 24,096.21, down 0.14%, after opening at 24,031.66. Oct 7 AKShare breadth was 679 advancers, 958 decliners and 1,174 flat. The narrower loss is not yet a bullish confirmation without HSTECH and heavyweight follow-through.
Overnight
Wall Street slipped as long yields hit small caps
On Oct 7 the Dow fell 0.66%, S&P 500 0.22%, Nasdaq 0.22% and Russell 2000 1.3%; the US 10-year closed near 5.28%. Micron rose 4.1% while TSMC fell 2.1%, so the chip signal is not one-way.
Industry
Huawei Mate 90 deepens the domestic stack
Huawei launched the Mate 90 with Kirin 9050 Pro and HarmonyOS 7, citing a 31% performance gain for top models. It also acknowledged constrained advanced-chip capacity and higher memory costs, leaving both upside and supply-side risk.
Industry
ACM backlog catalyst meets opening sector resistance
Backlog was RMB17.073bn as of Sep 29, up 88.2%, but no reliable same-day ACM quote was obtained. Google Finance's opening peer list showed SMIC -4.70% and AMEC -1.92%. The order thesis remains, but the stock stays a conditional watch with a higher confirmation bar.
Company
Sanan manager released from detention
The company said it received notice on Oct 5 that vice chairman and general manager Lin Kechuang had been released and can resume duties, with operations normal. This reduces governance uncertainty only at the margin and needs price confirmation.
Company
Feilong guides to a sharp profit decline
Nine-month attributable profit is guided at RMB95m-RMB117m, down 59.2%-66.87%, citing pricing competition, raw materials, FX and early-stage businesses. It closed Sep 30 at RMB45.38, down 2.45%, and is an avoid.
Company
Sunyes plans to buy control of Qiyuan Gas
Sunyes plans a share-and-cash acquisition of Qiyuan Gas control plus financing, likely a major asset restructuring. Trading is suspended from Oct 8 for up to 10 trading days. It closed limit-up at RMB9.10 on Sep 30; terms and dilution remain unknown.
Company
Rongfeng owner considers a control transfer
The controlling shareholder is planning a deal that may change control and the actual controller. Shares are suspended from Oct 8 for up to two trading days. The stock closed Sep 30 at RMB18.69, up 9.94%; no return is realized before terms and resumption.
HKEX
Z Fin suspended from Oct 7
An HKEX exchange notice says Z Fin (01168) was suspended from 9:00 a.m. on Oct 7. Until the reason and resumption conditions are verifiable, it is excluded from bullish candidates.

US Overnight Trading Summary

Overnight
Overnight Indexes
High-liquidity proxies checked at 09:40 CST showed QQQ -0.25% in cash trading and +0.11% after hours; DIA -0.69% in cash and -0.02% after hours; SPY's latest verifiable reading remained the -0.24% cash move. These are partly delayed proxies, not index futures.
Reconciliation
Sector Reconciliation
The US ranking snapshot misses the Oct 7 cash session, leaving zero industry and concept rows on the page and no representative tickers to reconcile. QQQ's shift from -0.25% cash to +0.11% after hours is a mild potential reversal, while DIA remained negative but narrowed; the combined verdict is divergence, not full confirmation.
Mapping
A/H Mapping
The mild US proxy recovery did not offset weakness in A-share chip peers at the open. Pharma and banks became the new strong lines while HSI stayed soft. Only improving semiconductor relative strength together with a positive HSTECH turn would invalidate the cautious view.

Premarket Conclusion

At 09:34 CST the Shanghai Composite and Shenzhen Component were up 0.30% and 0.18%, with pharma and banks leading as liquidity support translated into positive index returns.Opening weakness in semiconductor equipment/foundry peers and a still-negative HSI argue against carrying the pre-holiday tech thesis into a chase.ACM remains only a conditional watch with a higher relative-strength bar; suspended deals await terms and Feilong remains an avoid.

Focus Stocks

ACM Shanghai
A.688082
Conditional watch
Event: backlog reached RMB17.073bn, up 88.2%, directly tied to semiconductor equipment demand, but the company says backlog is not guaranteed revenue.
Latest feedback: no reliable same-day ACM quote was obtained. At 09:35 CST the peer list showed SMIC -4.70% and AMEC -1.92%, strengthening the sector counter-signal.
Confirm/invalidate: upgrade only after a reliable ACM quote shows volume and relative strength versus equipment/foundry peers; persistent sector lag or delivery delay invalidates.
Rongfeng Holdings
A.000668
Conditional watch
Event: the controlling shareholder is considering a transfer that may change the controller and actual controller.
Latest trade: Sep 30 close RMB18.69, +9.94%. Trading is suspended from Oct 8; the stock is not tradable and terms are undisclosed.
Confirm/invalidate: reassess only after resumption and disclosure of consideration and governance; no real asset injection, heavy dilution or negative resumption feedback invalidates.
Sunyes
A.002388
Conditional watch
Event: proposed share-and-cash acquisition of Qiyuan Gas control plus financing, likely a major restructuring.
Latest trade: Sep 30 limit-up close RMB9.10. Trading is suspended from Oct 8; valuation and dilution are unknown.
Confirm/invalidate: wait for full terms, exchange review and resumption pricing. An excessive valuation, heavy dilution or a sharp resumption drop invalidates.
Feilong Auto
A.002536
Avoid
Event: nine-month attributable profit is guided down 59.2%-66.87%; pricing competition and costs are material negatives.
Latest trade: Sep 30 close RMB45.38, -2.45%, with no post-announcement trade yet.
Avoid rationale: earnings deterioration compounds the negative pre-holiday price signal. Do not repackage the cooling theme as bullish without verified order conversion and margin recovery.

Sector Rotation Board

Pharma & banksBiological products +4.18%, pharma +2.09% and banks +1.46% became the new opening leaders; persistence depends on turnover and relative strength into late morning.
Semiconductor equipment/foundriesOrder catalysts remain, but SMIC and AMEC showed weak peer feedback at the open; ACM stays a conditional watch only.
M&A restructuringsRongfeng and Sunyes are suspended; only terms, review and resumption feedback can turn events into tradable conclusions.
Long-duration growthHigh long yields, soft Hong Kong and opening chip counter-signals together raise chase risk.

Logic Chain

PBOC net liquidity → modest positive reopening indexes → banks gain liquidity and low-valuation support, but still need sales and asset-quality confirmation.
Pharma leads at the open → rotation shifts from a tech-only expectation toward earnings/event-driven defensive growth → late-morning relative strength is the continuation test.
TSMC weak overnight plus soft A-share chip peers at the open → ACM's backlog lacks sector confirmation → retain only a conditional watch.
QQQ mildly recovers after hours but HSI stays negative → offshore risk improves only marginally → remain cautious until HSTECH turns positive and chip relative strength improves.

Risk Radar

Opening divergenceIndexes are modestly positive, but pharma/banks and chips moved in opposite directions; chasing a single holiday narrative risks a fast reversal.
Yields and oilThe US 10-year is near 5.28% and Brent near $100, pressuring long-duration and cost-sensitive sectors.
Deal-term vacuumRongfeng and Sunyes are suspended with core terms undisclosed; returns are unconfirmed.
Data freshnessA-share AKShare data are from Sep 30, Hong Kong from Oct 7 14:02 intraday, and US rankings miss the Oct 7 cash session; all are explicitly degraded.

Sources and Timestamps
